title: Spare Tire
body:
"This item literally does nothing - ANYWHO WEEEE CIRCLE"


Description

The Spare Tire is obtainable at the Lighthouse and can be purchased for $280.

Upon unboxing it reveals a spare tire, though its size varies randomly, ranging from small to large with each opening. Despite its variability, the Spare Tire serves no functional purpose other than serving as a decorative item.
